title: Vertical Economics & Model Fallback Readiness — Market Velocity Dossier
creator: Priya Menon
description: Purpose: Create a repeatable 'Market Velocity' dossier to help product and go-to-market teams decide when to onboard or switch model variants for specific enterprise verticals. Scope: define velocity signals, build compatibility & fallback scoring, prototype dashboard queries, and produce a prioritized action list for Dedicated/Private rollout plays. Background: sales asks for deterministic fallback strategies and economic tradeoffs when upstream model supply shifts. This ticket consolidates competitor signals, quantization/latency compatibility checks, and vertical economics for three pilot verticals (finserv, health, legal). Deliverables: 1) Velocity signal spec (data sources, thresholds, weighting), 2) Compatibility rubric (APIs, tokenization, quantization safety, latency), 3) Prototype workbook (BigQuery + Looker slices) with sample model-switch scenarios, 4) Decision runbook for eng and SEs (rollback, canary thresholds, customer comms). Success metrics: time-to-decision reduced from discovery to playbook adoption <= 10 working days; coverage: 90% of high-value customers mapped to at least one fallback strategy; reduction in P1 incidents attributable to model supply issues by 30% in first quarter after adoption. Out-of-scope: low-revenue SMB tiers, new model training. Data sources: public model release feeds, GitHub PRs, telemetry (latency/cost per-token), procurement/licensing notices, partner updates. Trade-offs: fast onboarding vs auditability; aggressive quantization may save cost but can increase semantic drift. Acceptance criteria: doc approved by PM lead and Solutions Eng, an initial Looker board with three vertical filters, and a validated fallback test run on staging with a simulated 20% throughput failover. Stakeholders: PM (Priya), Solutions Eng (Marco), Runtime Eng, Trust & Safety, Sales Ops. Risks: noisy signals, model behavior drift during quantized execution, legal constraints in regulated verticals. Next steps: schedule cross-functional workshop, wire sample queries, and line up two pilot enterprise customers for validation.
